name: @saralsystems/gridkit-mcp
stderr:
Usage: gridkit [options] [command]

GridKit MCP Installer - Power systems analysis tools for Claude

Options:
  -V, --version           output the version number
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  install [options]       Install GridKit MCPs to Claude Desktop
  uninstall [options]     Remove GridKit MCPs from Claude Desktop
  list                    List available GridKit agents
  verify [options]        Verify your API key is valid
  bridge [options] <url>  Internal use: Bridge to remote MCP
  help [command]          display help for command
